name: DePaul University
description:
DePaul University is a private Catholic university in Chicago, Illinois. Founded in 1898, the university takes its name from the 17th-century French priest Saint Vincent de Paul who spent his life serving the poor. In 1998, it became the largest Catholic university in terms of enrollment in North America. 

Committed to inclusion and diversity, there are 1114 international students studying at DePaul University currently.

What is the DePaul University acceptance rate for International Students?

The DePaul University acceptance rate is 64.9%.

The facilities available to students empower their learning experience. The classrooms are fully equipped with state of the art technology and other learning tools, with several of the rooms easy to locate around each campus. The DePaul Student Center has a range of facilities to offer students as it acts as a focal point for activity: a game room, food court, movie theater, fitness center and both study/social spaces provide students with recreational facilities.

Those interested in the performing arts are empowered with facilities such as the historic Merle Reskin Theatre or the Holtschneider Performance Center. Sports facilities and technology resources are in abundance at the university too.

Student Life

Connect with peers on campus at DePaul University. There is plenty of opportunity to do so as a huge 350 student organizations are registered for students to join, ensuring there is a society for everyone at the university. Similarly, there is a wealth of volunteer opportunities so students can develop their leadership skills and get involved in community-based initiatives that also look great on their CV. A variety of campus events are hosted throughout the year that range from lectures and talks to cultural festivals, concerts and more. There is never a dull moment at DePaul university.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
DePaul University has a variety of on-campus accommodation available. Traditional halls of residence provide students with the customary student experience and present the chance to meet like-minded people. DePaul University has two campuses, the Lincoln Park Campus and Loop Campus. Students can benefit from fully furnished housing that comes complete with all the customary amenities you would expect to find in a halls of residence.

Resources are available for students who want to live off-campus but close enough to easily reach the university. The university can help with finding roommates and understanding the housing market. Housing services are also available for students both on and off campus, consisting of maintenance and repairs, housing policies, guidelines and even mediation in the face of conflict.
